hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE 'src/.*\.tsx$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder (.claude/rules/styling.md): use NativeWind className with semantic tokens. Inline style={} is allowed ONLY for: (1) Reanimated animatedStyle, (2) dynamic runtime values, (3) third-party components without className support, (4) style={themeVars} on the root layout. jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(tailwind\.config\.js|global\.css|src/constants/palettes\.ts)$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"You just edited a theming file (palettes.ts, global.css, or tailwind.config.js).
